strongs_1890.strongs_def: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
